description: Sorts and cleans the Downloads folder: deletes old installer/archive files and moves others into matching category folders.

fields.name: SourceDir
fields.label: Folder to clean
fields.helpText: The Downloads folder this script sorts and cleans.
fields.helpDetail: Only files directly in this folder are checked — subfolders are ignored. Deletes go through the XDG Trash (same filesystem only — gio cannot trash across filesystems, and such failures surface as skips, never silent loss). You can point this at a different folder, but it should be a dedicated downloads-style folder.

fields.name: CutoffDays
fields.label: Only touch files older than
fields.helpText: Files younger than this are left untouched.
fields.helpDetail: Age is based on the file's last write time. 0 means every file counts as old. Younger files are left alone even if they match the delete list, a category, or an Advanced Rule.

fields.name: DeleteExts
fields.label: Extensions to delete
fields.helpText: Files with these extensions are deleted instead of moved. One extension per tag, starting with a dot.
fields.helpDetail: These files go to the XDG Trash, not permanent delete. Other old files are moved into category folders. If an Advanced Rule exists for the same extension, that rule wins — even if the extension is listed here.

fields.name: IgnorePatterns
fields.label: Filename patterns to never touch
fields.helpText: Files whose name matches any pattern are never touched, regardless of extension rules.
fields.helpDetail: Glob-style patterns matched against the filename only (not the folder path), ignoring case — e.g. pinned_* keeps every file starting with pinned_, *keep* keeps any file with keep in the name. Checked before Advanced Rules, the delete list, and category moves: an ignored filename wins over everything. Leave empty for default behavior.
